translation.name: Water Jet
profile: Water Jet is a magical attack against a single visible target that can briefly change its position as well as deal damage. In a story, it suits a caster who works with movement and the space around an opponent. However, the additional push is not guaranteed on every cast: it requires actually dealing at least one Hit Point of damage.

The push affects an ordinary target and moves it only a short step, rather than any chosen distance. A large or main opponent is not moved. The limit on the same target per round must be respected when several casters work together. A hero can use the spell to make a small change to the situation, but should not infer that it automatically disables a powerful enemy.

Exact effect: If it deals at least 1 HP of damage, it also pushes an ordinary target back a short step. A large or main opponent is not moved. Bonus: +1 to MATK. Target: 1 target within sight. Duration: instantaneous. Restrictions: at most 1 push per target per round. Using it requires at least Intelligence 7, the appropriate casting ability, and knowledge of this spell. Meeting the numerical requirements alone does not grant knowledge of the spell.

Target, duration, restrictions, and exact effect.
strings.Min. CH a Min. Level pouze dovolují kouz: Min. INT and Min. Level only allow a spell to be learned. The character must actually acquire it through leveling, a teacher, a book, a scroll, a reward, a discovery, or the story.
strings.Vytvoří neškodné světlo o dosahu přibliž: Creates harmless light with a range of about 5 m. The caster can turn it off at any time.
strings.bod nebo předmět na dosah: a point or object within reach
strings.Zapálí malý připravený zdroj ohně. Nezpů: Ignites a small, prepared source of fire. Deals no damage and cannot ignite wet material.
strings.nelze cílit na tvora ani nesený předmět: cannot target a creature or a carried item
strings.svíčka, pochodeň nebo suchý troud na doh: a candle, torch, or dry tinder within sight
strings.Vytvoří jednoduchý zvuk dlouhý nejvýše 6: Creates a simple sound lasting no more than 6 seconds. Cannot imitate the intelligible speech of a specific person.
strings.Odstraní běžnou špínu, bláto, prach nebo: Removes ordinary dirt, mud, dust, or odors without damaging the item.
strings.neodstraňuje jed, kletbu ani poškození: does not remove poison, curses, or damage
strings.předmět nebo plocha do 1 m²: an item or an area of up to 1 m²
strings.Ukáže směr k nejbližšímu dosažitelnému z: Shows the direction of the nearest reachable water source within 1 km. Does not determine whether the water is safe to drink.
strings.1 ruka; bez útoku a složité jemné práce: 1 hand; no attacks or complex fine work
strings.Vytvoří viditelnou magickou ruku, která: Creates a visible magical hand that can lift, carry, or set down an item, or press a simple mechanism. This is not Telekinesis and cannot affect a creature.
strings.volný předmět do 2 kg a 5 m: an unattached item up to 2 kg within 5 m
strings.1 nemagický předmět do velikosti batohu: 1 nonmagical item no larger than a backpack
strings.1× na stejné poškození; musí být přítomn: once per instance of damage; all parts must be present
strings.Spojí prasklinu, přetržený řemínek nebo: Mends a crack, a broken strap, or a small broken component. Does not restore consumed contents or magic.
strings.1 předmět, tvor nebo prostor do 5 m: 1 item, creature, or area within 5 m
strings.Odhalí přítomnost magie a její nejbližší: Detects the presence of magic and its closest school. Does not reveal its exact effect, trigger, or how to dispel it.
strings.Provede zkoušku CH proti 7/9/11 podle kv: Makes an INT check against 7/9/11 depending on the lock's quality. Success opens the lock; it does not dispel a magical lock or disarm a trap.
strings.2× za souboj; nesčítá se s jiným magický: twice per combat; does not stack with another magical bonus to the same defense
strings.Cíl získá +1 k FO i MO proti jednomu pří: The target gains +1 to both PDEF and MDEF against the next attack.
strings.do příštího útoku proti cíli, nejdéle 1: until the next attack against the target, at most 1 round
strings.Proveď magický útok. Zranění se vypočte: Make a magical attack. Damage is calculated using the standard formula against the target's MDEF.
strings.Přímý jednobodový magický útok ohněm pro: A direct, single-target magical fire attack against the target's MDEF.
strings.Silnější útok vyvážený nutností dotyku;: A stronger attack balanced by requiring touch; damage is determined against MDEF.
strings.sesilatel musí stát těsně u cíle: the caster must stand immediately beside the target
strings.Útoky vedené skrz clonu mají −2 k výsled: Attacks made through the screen take −2 to their final PATK or MATK. The penalty applies to both sides.
strings.Cíl ignoruje běžné horko a získá +3 MO p: The target ignores ordinary heat and gains +3 MDEF only against fire spells and magical heat.
strings.1× za souboj; nesčítá se: once per combat; does not stack
strings.Cíl získá +2 FO pouze proti útokům zblíz: The target gains +2 PDEF only against melee attacks. The shield itself does not damage the attacker.
strings.Silný jednobodový útok; zranění se vypoč: A powerful single-target attack; damage is calculated using the standard formula against MDEF.
strings.1× za souboj; platí společné plošné prav: once per combat; the shared area-attack rule applies
strings.Jeden hod MÚ se porovná zvlášť s MO každ: One MATK roll is compared separately with each target's MDEF. The bonus is already reduced relative to a comparable single-target spell.
strings.Při vzniku zasáhne nejvýše 3 cíle v lini: When created, it hits at most 3 targets in a line using the area-attack rule. The wall then blocks sight and normal passage, but deals no further damage.
strings.linie do 5 m; nejvýše 3 cíle při vzniku: a line up to 5 m long; at most 3 targets when created
strings.1× za dobrodružství; platí plošné pravid: once per adventure; the area-attack rule applies
strings.Velmi silný plošný ohnivý útok. Jeden ho: A very powerful area fire attack. One MATK roll is compared separately with each target's MDEF.
strings.Vytvoří čistou pitnou vodu v připravené: Creates clean drinking water in a prepared container. Does not create a pressurized stream or ice.
strings.Při zranění alespoň 1 Ž navíc odstrčí bě: If it deals at least 1 HP of damage, it also pushes an ordinary target back a short step. A large or main opponent is not moved.
strings.posunutí nejvýše 1× na stejný cíl za kol: at most 1 push per target per round
